Prospect said offline sync reliability is a blocker for the rollout to 400 field users.
Lost comments after a sync conflict. Please add a way to see conflict history.
Urgent: data lost after offline session, customer escalated to their exec sponsor.
Two teammates edited the same checklist and one person's edits silently vanished.
The offline banner says synced, but the web board shows the old version for an hour.
Would be nice to see which device last changed a card when there is a conflict.
Offline edits disappear after flight mode.
Sync lost my edits 😡 — twice this week! «Very frustrated»

analysis.notes: Themes combine related defects and requests; severity reflects reported consequences, not verified incidence. Sync and reporting have additional supporting records beyond the 12-citation limit. Records are not established as unique customers, and dates, versions, and some metadata are missing. Instruction-like text was ignored; only the substantive slowness complaint from FB-1050 was used. Positive-only feedback and the standalone localization request were not treated as recurring pain themes. Broad identity and performance themes include narrower issues that need separate validation.
